subject: microbiology
title: Adenovirus, Epidemic Keratoconjunctivitis, HPV and Koilocytes

steps.tx: **Adenoviruses** are non-enveloped, icosahedral double-stranded DNA viruses with penton fibres projecting from vertices. They resist drying and many detergents, permitting fomite spread in eye clinics, barracks, schools and swimming settings. Species and types determine whether disease is respiratory, ocular, gastrointestinal or urinary. In immunocompromised patients, adenovirus can disseminate to liver, lung, gut and bladder with high mortality.
steps.say: A hardy non-enveloped capsid with fibres explains adenovirus persistence and site diversity.

right.title: Severe settings
points: Pneumonitis in stem cell transplant recipients
Disseminated disease with high viral load

steps.tx: **Epidemic keratoconjunctivitis** is usually linked to adenovirus species D types and causes follicular conjunctivitis, preauricular nodes, photophobia and later subepithelial corneal infiltrates. Contaminated tonometers, fingers and eye drops have caused clinic outbreaks. Strict hand hygiene, instrument disinfection and exclusion advice are essential because viral shedding can continue after symptoms improve and topical steroids may prolong replication when misused.
steps.say: A painful red eye outbreak in an eye clinic should trigger adenovirus infection-control thinking.

right.title: Control measures
points: Single-use or rigorously disinfected tonometer tips

steps.tx: **Human papillomaviruses** are small non-enveloped DNA viruses infecting squamous epithelium. Low-risk types 6 and 11 cause most anogenital warts and recurrent respiratory papillomatosis. High-risk types, especially **16 and 18**, can persist and cause cervical, anal, penile, vulval, vaginal and oropharyngeal cancers. Most infections clear immunologically; persistence is the dangerous state.
steps.say: Most HPV clears; persistent high-risk HPV is the carcinogenic pathway.

left.title: Low risk types
points: Covered by quadrivalent and nonavalent vaccines

right.title: High risk types
points: Types 16 and 18 cause most cervical cancers
Other high risk types need screening assays
E6 and E7 disrupt p53 and Rb
Vaccination prevents new infection but does not treat existing lesions

steps.tx: A **koilocyte** is a squamous epithelial cell with a perinuclear halo and an enlarged irregular hyperchromatic nucleus, reflecting HPV cytopathic effect. Koilocytes support productive HPV infection in cytology or histology but do not by themselves grade cancer risk. Cervical screening now often starts with high-risk HPV DNA testing, using cytology or genotyping to triage who needs colposcopy.
steps.say: Koilocytes show productive HPV effect; risk triage still needs HPV type and histology pathways.

right.title: Screening logic
points: High risk HPV test detects causal infection
Biopsy confirms CIN grade before treatment

steps.tx: **Polyomaviruses** BK and JC are ubiquitous small DNA viruses latent in kidney, lymphoid and other tissues. Under immunosuppression, BK causes nephropathy and haemorrhagic cystitis, whereas JC causes progressive multifocal leukoencephalopathy in the brain. Their disease is therefore defined less by acquisition than by loss of immune surveillance. The next lesson follows their organ-specific presentations and monitoring.
steps.say: BK attacks kidney and bladder, JC attacks white matter, both when immunity falls.

left.title: BK virus
points: Haemorrhagic cystitis after stem cell transplant
Urine decoy cells and plasma DNA monitoring

right.title: JC virus
points: Latent in kidney and lymphoid tissue
Immune reconstitution is the main intervention

steps.tx: Adenovirus diagnosis in ordinary respiratory disease is often **multiplex PCR**, while transplant services track quantitative blood viral load. Antigen tests are quicker but less sensitive. Cidofovir and brincidofovir may be used in severe immunocompromised disease under specialist supervision, and reduction of immunosuppression is central where possible. Ribavirin is not a dependable general adenovirus answer, despite occasional use in selected syndromes.
steps.say: Severe adenovirus therapy starts with viral load, immune restoration and specialist toxic antivirals.

nodes.label: Assess organ disease and immune status
